observations.countingSemantics: Each METHOD plus route path is one observed HTTP entrypoint.
observations.notes: Includes cross-product and administrative routes that import Editron code. It is not a count of editing capabilities.

observations.countingSemantics: Each resolved returned tool name is one bundle entry.
observations.notes: This is the compatibility bundle before request-time exposure and policy filtering.

observations.countingSemantics: Each object property is one central chat metadata descriptor.
observations.notes: Descriptor presence does not prove runtime inclusion, shared ownership, mutation safety or certification.

observations.countingSemantics: Each non-research source file containing executeDirectorPlan is one observed caller/definition surface.
observations.notes: The list includes the defining module and callers; Phase 3 must distinguish them and trace actual control flow.

observations.countingSemantics: Each function-typed EditorContextProps member is one observed manual/client operation surface.
observations.notes: The interface mixes editing, playback, rendering, persistence and UI state; rows are not yet atomic capabilities.

observations.countingSemantics: Each useHotkeys binding string is one observed shortcut declaration.
observations.notes: Comma-separated alternatives remain one binding declaration and are not counted as separate capabilities.

observations.countingSemantics: Each non-private/non-protected class method is one observed ProjectService method.
observations.notes: Public method presence does not prove CAS, receipt, proof or planner eligibility.

observations.countingSemantics: Each matching current source module path is one proof/render/delivery candidate surface.
observations.notes: Filename discovery is intentionally broad; Phase 3 must identify owners, consumers, duplicates and dead modules.

observations.countingSemantics: Each unique OverlayType case in LayerContent is one observed main renderer case.
observations.notes: Grouped cases are counted by enum case. Default null and side-panel-only overlay types are not renderer support.

observations.countingSemantics: Each OverlayType enum string value is one observed editor state discriminator.
observations.notes: The enum contains both timeline-rendered media and panel-only/non-rendered state.

observations.countingSemantics: Each matching current source module path is one worker/job candidate surface.
observations.notes: Filename discovery is intentionally broad and does not establish dispatch reachability, authentication or authority.
